attestation.basis: 631 graded forecasts of 869 recorded on the ledger (mean scores: no numeric mean scores); graded record only, no calibrated out of sample evaluation has been attested, so this engine's numbers are published as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

probability_rendering.reason: no calibrated out of sample attestation on record for this engine; its numbers may be published only as uncalibrated scores, never as probabilities

features_absent: The overnight gap's share of the distance: the card record carries no session open for a card's grading session, so this reading is absent, not estimated.
Days to the biggest expiry: the cards carry no expiry breakdown, so this reading is absent, not estimated.
The wall strike's size against its neighbouring strikes: the cards carry the wall strikes only, so this reading is absent, not estimated.

history.label: History: the record so far, graded after the fact

kill_criterion: After 60 cards per index, this tool is retired if its 5-session touch chances are off by more than 10 points on average, or if its break chances score no better than the plain overall break rate.
